correctness.rationale: Every pointed rank-one type in the binary order-and-colour vocabulary is the exact triple (letter, left colours, right colours), and existential realization of all such triples characterizes rank-two sentences. The square/cube formulas are proved by copy decomposition. The exact prefix-state recurrence is closed on 37 reachable states (32 using both colours), so the exhaustive 30/16 image counts and sharp roots range over ALL word lengths; no finite prefix cutoff is assumed. A standard-library verifier replays the 37-state complete graph and its certificate, checks the 90 background unrestricted classes, direct literal signatures, game inequivalence, distinct images and the minimal-root histograms. The algebraic copy formula independently proves stabilization for every exponent >=3; 01 yields rank-two inequivalent square and cube.

value.rationale: Repeated motifs (powers) are a canonical family of finite labelled traces. The rank-two power-image hierarchy determines exactly which bounded-depth theories have periodic witnesses, gives finite optimal test-period bounds (six/five), and exhibits a sharp transition between two and three copies. Complete natural classifications and shortest-root cutoffs have intrinsic model-theoretic use and are not supplied by correctness or a generic finite-index theorem alone.
